resources.string: Search for tracks on Spotify and add them to your progression. Connect Spotify App first.
Search & add songs from Spotify. We use your paid Spotify membership to stream the ringer directly from the Spotify App.
Please ensure the Spotify App is installed and you are logged in.
You can also use local audio files (MP3/WAV/M4A) by selecting them from your device.
Tip: Share audio files from apps like Zedge to import them here.
⚠️ RingerSong will automatically silence your default ringer while playing, but setting your phone\'s ringtone to Silent is a good backup.
